free_text_notes.physician_note: 77-year-old man with asthma, hypertension, admitted 2/24 with left lower lobe pneumonia with small parapneumonic effusion. Oxygen weaned to room air yesterday.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Vitals stable this shift. Tolerating diet. Speech-language pathology (swallow) has not seen the patient yet. A repeat chest X-ray taken on day 4 shows the pneumonia is clearing as expected. The radiologist confirmed this is consistent with a good recovery. A routine palliative care screening question was included in the admission assessment as per standard protocol. The patient did not meet the criteria for a palliative care referral.
free_text_notes.case_manager_note: Discharge planning in progress; CM following daily. 3/3 13:00: Son called: has to travel for a family emergency tonight and cannot stay with the patient. No other family available.
